repo.ISSUE.md: label_shipments gives me the lookup, but `lines` is always empty. I expected one line per shipment.

fix.code:
def label_shipments(names, shipments):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> weight dict and one 'name: weight' line per shipment."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.weight for x in shipments)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
